appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.themeHelp: This applies across every project and device you log in from.
appearance.languageHelp: Changes the language of the app immediately, across every project and device you log in from.

palette.title: System Color Palette
palette.description: Admin-only. This changes the color scheme for every user, across the whole app.

email.title: Email Configuration
email.description: Admin-only. Controls how invite emails are sent. Fields set via environment variables take precedence and can't be edited here.

backups.title: Backups
backups.description: Admin-only. Configure automatic database backups, trigger one on demand, and restore from a previous backup.

recaptcha.title: reCAPTCHA
recaptcha.description: Admin-only. Configure Google reCAPTCHA for the Login, Register, and Admin Setup pages. Fields set via environment variables take precedence and can't be edited here.

twoFactor.title: Two-Factor Authentication
twoFactor.description: Add an extra layer of security to your account. Once enabled, deletions and admin settings changes you make also require it.

twoFactorBanner.message: Enable Two-Factor Authentication on your account (Personal tab) to save settings or run backups.

chooseMethod.title: Choose a Method
chooseMethod.totpOptionHelp: Use an app like Google Authenticator or Authy.
chooseMethod.emailOptionHelp: Receive codes at your account email address.
chooseMethod.emailUnavailable: Ask an admin to configure email settings first.

totpSetup.title: Set Up Authenticator App
totpSetup.instructions: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app, or enter the secret manually.
totpSetup.codeLabel: Enter the 6-digit code from your app

emailSetup.title: Set Up Email Verification
emailSetup.instructions: We sent a verification code to your email address.

backupCodes.title: Save Your Backup Codes
backupCodes.description: Use one of these codes to sign in if you lose access to your authenticator app or email. Each code works once.
backupCodes.acknowledge: I've saved these codes somewhere safe

regenerateModal.title: Regenerate Backup Codes
regenerateModal.description: This invalidates your existing backup codes. Enter your password to confirm.

disableModal.title: Disable Two-Factor Authentication
disableModal.description: This removes the extra layer of security from your account, including access to any actions that require it. Enter your password to confirm.

paletteEditor.pickPresetHelp: Pick a preset (each thumbnail's diagonal shows its light/dark primary color), or customize every color individually.

backupSettings.restoreDescriptionIntro: This is a single-process restore — the app is not restarted, but in-flight requests may transiently fail while the restore runs. The connection pool reconnects automatically afterward; no manual restart is needed.
